options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Cradle: Beat Cradle. All Missions: Beat all 20. All Missions All Difficulties: Why do you hate
yourself?
options.doc_fr: Cradle: Battre le berceau. Toutes les missions : battre les 20. Toutes les missions Toutes les difficultés : Pourquoi vous détestez-vous ?

options.name: Starting Mission
options.doc: Which mission starts unlocked

options.name: Mission Clear Mode
options.doc: Each map is one check or one check per difficulty per stage (20 locations vs 60)

options.name: Objective Mode
options.doc:
Choose whether objectives are tracked separately per difficulty or shared across all
difficulties.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez si les objectifs sont suivis séparément par difficulté ou partagés entre toutes les difficultés.

options.name: Progressive Weapons
options.doc:
Makes the progression more interesting. It's like gun game, but you unlock them in order up to
Golden Gun, but starting with Klobb lol

options.name: Add Extra Levels
options.doc: Enable Aztec, Egyptian, or both

options.name: Shuffle Items
options.doc: Choose for freestanding, NPC Drops and Handoffs, and Key items to be shuffled.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez pour l'autonomie, NPC gouttes et poignées, et les éléments clés à mélanger.

options.name: Gun Pickups
options.doc:
Choose if guns will be allowed to be picked up from guards, just the ammo, or not at all.
Intended option for this randomizer is just ammo as you unlock guns through progressive weapon
option.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez si les armes seront permises à des gardes, juste les munitions, ou pas du tout.
Option prévue pour ce randomisateur est juste des munitions que vous déverrouillez des armes par l'option d'arme progressive.

options.name: Body Armor Sanity
options.doc: Body armor locations send checks
options.doc_fr: Les armures du corps envoient des vérifications

options.name: Ammo Crate Sanity
options.doc: Ammo Crate locations send checks
options.doc_fr: Ammo Les emplacements des caisses envoient des vérifications

options.name: Cheats Shuffler
options.doc:
Cheat Unlock level speedruns are now locations for checks, and cheats are now items in the pool
that will automatically enable.
options.doc_fr: Cheat Déverrouiller les vitesses de niveau sont maintenant des endroits pour les vérifications, et les tricheurs sont maintenant des éléments dans la piscine qui vont automatiquement activer.

options.name: Skip Cutscenes
options.doc: Set to true if you've seen enough of that fucking green truck and want to just play

options.name: Randomize Music
options.doc: Level, intro and menu music will be randomized.

options.name: Randomize Enemies
options.doc: Enemy and Bond models will be randomized. Enemy positions and behaviors stay the same.

options.name: Randomize Enemy Loadouts
options.doc: Enemy weapons can be anything for every enemy in either or both hands

options.name: SFX Randomization
options.doc:
Weapons Only shuffles attacks, slappers, throws, reloads, clicks and switches. Categories
combines attacks, explosions and impacts; ricochets/flybys and casings each stay separate.
Equip, reload and click sounds join electronics/interface. True Random shuffles all sound
effects. Continuous sounds retain their stop behavior. Off keeps native sounds.

options.doc: Pretty self explainatory honestly...

options.name: Holster Gun Trap
options.doc: Oh, whoops, ooh! I dropped my magnum

options.name: Auto Fail Trap

options.name: Trap Chance

options.doc_fr: Une chance pour que la malbouffe devienne un piège (0=none 100=fuck you)
